payload.title: Figure 4
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook is focused on generating Figure 4, which illustrates the emergent constraint produced by various relationships from the last millennium. It compares these constraints to the full ensemble and the original Cox et al. (2018) constraint using the Bowman et al. (2018) method. The notebook utilizes statistical methods to compute metrics such as the Cox and Nijsse metrics, and visualizes the results using matplotlib. The outputs include a plot saved as 'figure_4.png', which displays the emergent constraints and their comparison to model ECS values.
